description: Combines up to seven gate or trigger signals onto two busses, each row able to feed bus A, bus B, both or neither

params.text: Includes that row's input in bus A while it is lit
Includes that row's input in bus B while it is lit

inputs.text: The gate or trigger for that row, counted as high above 2V and added to each bus whose button is lit on that row

outputs.text: Goes to 10V while any row switched into bus A has a high signal, and 0V otherwise
Goes to 10V while any row switched into bus B has a high signal, and 0V otherwise

notes: every bus button starts unlit, so nothing reaches A or B until a button is lit
